subject: Renewal & Expansion QBR + Roadmap Demo — scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@fintechco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal & Expansion QBR + Roadmap Demo — proposed times

Hi Sarah,

Hope you had a good week. As we approach your renewal conversation, we'd like to schedule a combined QBR + roadmap demo to:

- Review usage and outcomes from the last 12 months
- Walk through our product roadmap and how it maps to FinTechCo's expansion needs
- Agree on the mutual action plan and next steps for the renewal/expansion (including seats and Dedicated capacity sizing)

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Mar 9, 10:00–11:00am
- Wed Mar 10, 2:00–3:00pm
- Thu Mar 11, 9:00–10:00am

Attached is a draft agenda and a mutual action plan workbook for prep. Can you let me know which slot works best or share a couple alternatives?

Attendees we plan to bring: me (AM), Laura (Sales Engineer), Vivek (Customer Success lead) — feel free to add anyone from your side.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0143

Attachments: agenda_qbr_v2.pdf (PDF), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion QBR + Roadmap Demo — proposed times

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the note and the materials. Wed Mar 10 is great in principle, but we've just locked in a leadership offsite that afternoon. Would it be possible to move to either Tue Mar 9 at 10am or Thu Mar 11 in the morning? If neither works, I can propose a couple of afternoons next week.

Also tagging Mike (cc) who is taking point on the expansion side for FinTechCo. He may want to make sure the roadmap covers latency & cost optimizations for our high-volume flows.

Best,
Sarah

Thanks Sarah — Tue Mar 9 at 10:00am PST works on our side. I've penciled that slot.

To make the session most useful, quick ask: could you (or Mike) share the top 3 success metrics you want covered during the QBR and any particular latency/cost thresholds we should be mindful of? That'll help Laura and Vivek tailor the demo and the recommendations in the mutual action plan.

I've attached the two files again in case the first email didn't come through. I will send a calendar invite once we confirm.

Agenda (short):
1) 10m – Introductions & renewal objectives
2) 20m – Usage review & outcomes
3) 20m – Roadmap demo (focus on throughput/latency/cost controls)
4) 10m – Mutual action plan & next steps

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Marissa

Attachments: agenda_qbr_v2.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@fintechco.com>, Mike O'Connell <mike.oconnell@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T07:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion QBR + Roadmap Demo — proposed times

Jumping in — thanks for coordinating. A couple of internal notes so we come prepared:

- Laura, please prioritize a short demo segment on Dedicated autoscaling and the cost controls (batching + quantization) — FinTechCo's peak windows were the main pain point last quarter.
- Marissa, I'll bring the renewal worksheet and a rough commitment-level estimate so we can discuss Reserved Capacity options during the session.
- Sarah/Mike: if you can share any example peak-day logs or token volume profiles ahead of the meeting (redacted is fine), it will help us make the sizing talk concrete.

I'll leave scheduling to Marissa.

—Vivek
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion QBR + Roadmap Demo — proposed times

Hi all —

Thanks, Marissa. Tue Mar 9 at 10:00am PST is confirmed for us — Mike will join and he asked me to pass along two quick items:

1) Top metrics to cover: average 95th percentile latency (ms), cost per 1k tokens during peak windows, and error rate for fallback responses.
2) I'll upload a redacted peak-day token profile to the shared drive by EOD Monday — link below.

Looking forward to the session. Could someone please send the calendar invite and include dial-in details?

Best,
Sarah
